goal: Integrate the frozen dual-XGMII HFT baseline with the frozen RMIC M5.4 transactional core without modifying either upstream, while closing TAIFEX futures accounting, execution idempotency, safety-policy, timing, and end-to-end validation gaps.
handoff: Repository governance and the I2 multi-account/multi-product futures state manager are CI-verified. The first state-manager run exposed a testbench ready/valid race, fixed at b889527; I2 now moves to committed execution/order-context integration.
next_action: Design and verify an integration-owned futures order metadata store plus committed R02/R32 bridge so order_id resolves account/product/PositionEffect before mutating futures state.

tasks.title: Adopt repository governance and phase workflow
tasks.acceptance: Canonical project records, AGENTS policy, layout/results policies, sync/layout checks and CI governance checks are present and passing.

tasks.title: Implement multi-account/multi-product futures state manager
tasks.acceptance: Independent account/product state, OPEN/CLOSE long/short reservations and fills are self-checking with no cross-account contamination and fail-closed invalid access.

tasks.title: Bind committed R02/R32 execution events
tasks.acceptance: Only sequence-owner committed reports mutate state; duplicate/replay/gap cases cannot double-apply partial fills or releases, and order_id resolves the exact state key/PositionEffect through integration-owned order context.

tasks.title: Measure state-manager OOC timing/resources
tasks.acceptance: Vivado 2022.1 OOC at 6.400 ns reports WNS >= 0, TNS = 0 and reviewed utilization.

tasks.title: Build CL2EX futures risk gate around frozen RMIC order lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Risk-rejected orders never enter R01; accepted payload remains byte-identical to frozen HFT behavior.

milestones.summary: HFT and RMIC upstreams pinned as read-only submodules at frozen pre-integration baselines.
Order field mapping and fail-closed policy shell established with integration-level reject namespace.
Futures accounting v1 separates long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics using a host-configured margin-per-contract research model; not a TAIFEX SPAN claim.
Integration-owned R02/R32 fixed-offset PositionEffect tap fills the execution field missing from the frozen HFT decoder; mutation authority remains with committed report ownership.
LOB-inspired phase governance adopted: canonical project state, append-only decisions, living ExecPlan, one phase branch/PR, evidence-layer boundaries and mechanical governance CI.

Multi-account/product futures state manager regression passed key isolation, short open, long close, margin reject, fail-closed ownership, config priority and reset-recovery cases. Initial CI timeout was a testbench handshake race and is preserved in the I2 plan.
